name: Frame Window Recorder
description: Records a successful macro first, then measures the real frame window of each input by replaying shifted inputs against Geometry Dash itself.

max-shift.name: Max probe shift
max-shift.description: Maximum number of 240 TPS physics frames to test early and late for each input.

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases
analyze-releases.description: Also measure release timing windows. Disable to measure presses only.

inject-offset.name: Replay inject offset
inject-offset.description: If a clean macro replay is consistently one tick off, try -1 or +1.
